scenarios.name: Hero Section and Value Proposition
scenarios.description: Validates that the hero section displays a clear value proposition headline, supporting text highlighting key benefits, and prominent CTAs for registration and login. Tests that users can understand the service within 5 seconds of page load.

steps.description: Load the homepage at the root URL (/) to verify hero section renders
steps.context: User lands on homepage from search, referral, or direct URL

steps.description: Check that H1 headline clearly communicates URL shortening service purpose
steps.context: Headline should be prominent and immediately visible above the fold

steps.description: Confirm supporting paragraph explains key benefits (analytics, easy sharing)
steps.context: Value proposition should be clear within 5 seconds

steps.description: Check 'Get Started' primary button and 'Sign In' secondary link are visible and above the fold
steps.context: CTAs must be prominent and accessible

test_cases.input: Navigate to / and check for H1 element with value proposition text
test_cases.expected: H1 element exists with text containing 'URL', 'shorten', or 'link' keywords indicating service purpose

test_cases.input: Check for supporting paragraph element in hero section
test_cases.expected: Paragraph exists mentioning 'analytics', 'tracking', or 'sharing' benefits

test_cases.input: Query for 'Get Started' or 'Sign Up' button in hero section
test_cases.expected: Primary CTA button exists and is visible
Navigation to /register route occurs

test_cases.input: Query for 'Sign In' or 'Login' link in hero section
test_cases.expected: Secondary CTA link exists and is visible
Navigation to /login route occurs

test_cases.input: Verify hero section renders with BackgroundEffect
test_cases.expected: BackgroundEffect component is present and renders without errors

test_cases.input: Check CTA button visibility on 1024px viewport (desktop)
test_cases.expected: Get Started button is visible above the fold (within first 600px vertical)

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Validates that the features section displays at least 3 key features (URL shortening, click analytics, shareable stats) with icons, titles, and descriptions in a responsive grid layout.

steps.description: Navigate past hero section to view features section
steps.context: Features section should be easily discoverable

steps.description: Confirm at least 3 feature cards are displayed with proper structure
steps.context: Each card should have icon, title, and description

steps.description: Check that URL shortening, analytics, and sharing features are represented
steps.context: These are the core value propositions

steps.description: Confirm 3-column grid on desktop, 1-column on mobile

test_cases.expected: Features section exists with accessible landmark or id='features'

test_cases.input: Count feature cards in features section
test_cases.expected: At least 3 feature cards are rendered
Each card contains an icon element, heading (title), and paragraph (description)

test_cases.input: Search for URL shortening feature content
test_cases.expected: One feature card mentions 'short', 'shorten', or 'link' in title or description
One feature card mentions 'analytics', 'track', 'click', or 'statistics'
One feature card mentions 'share', 'sharing', or 'shareable'

test_cases.input: Verify GlassMorphismCard styling on feature cards
test_cases.expected: Feature cards use GlassMorphismCard component or equivalent styling

test_cases.input: Check grid layout at 1024px viewport width
test_cases.expected: Feature cards display in 3-column grid layout

test_cases.input: Check grid layout at 375px viewport width
test_cases.expected: Feature cards stack vertically in single column

scenarios.name: How It Works Section
scenarios.description: Validates the 'How It Works' section displays a 3-step process (Create short link, Share anywhere, Track analytics) with visual indicators and responsive layout (horizontal on desktop, vertical on mobile).

steps.action: Navigate to How It Works section
steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the How It Works section of the homepage
steps.context: Section should be clearly labeled and discoverable

steps.description: Confirm exactly 3 steps are displayed with proper content
steps.context: Steps: Create short link, Share anywhere, Track analytics

steps.description: Check that each step has a number or icon indicator
Confirm horizontal stepper on desktop, vertical on mobile

test_cases.input: Query for 'How It Works' section heading or container
test_cases.expected: Section exists with heading containing 'How It Works' or similar text

test_cases.input: Count step elements in How It Works section
test_cases.expected: Exactly 3 step elements are rendered
First step mentions 'create', 'paste', 'URL', or 'short link'
Second step mentions 'share', 'social', 'email', or 'anywhere'
Third step mentions 'track', 'analytics', 'clicks', or 'statistics'
Each step displays a number (1, 2, 3) or numbered icon
Visual connectors exist between steps (line, arrow, or separator)
Steps are arranged horizontally (flex-row or grid with 3 columns)
Steps are arranged vertically (flex-col or single column)

scenarios.name: Trust Indicators and Statistics
scenarios.description: Validates that optional trust indicators/statistics are displayed (URLs created, clicks tracked) to build credibility with visitors.

steps.description: Scroll to the statistics/trust indicators section if present
steps.context: This is a 'Could' priority feature - may be optional

steps.description: Check that relevant statistics are shown (URLs, clicks, users)
Confirm statistics are displayed in an engaging, readable format
steps.context: May include counter animations or icons

test_cases.expected: Stats section exists (if implemented as 'Could' priority feature)
Statistic showing count of URLs shortened is displayed
Statistic showing total clicks tracked is displayed
Large numbers are formatted with commas or abbreviated (e.g., 1.2M)
Each statistic has a descriptive label explaining what it represents

scenarios.description: Validates the final CTA section with reinforcing call-to-action and proper navigation links to registration and login pages.

steps.description: Scroll to the bottom CTA section of the homepage
Check for reinforcing call-to-action message
Confirm registration and login links work correctly
steps.context: Links should navigate to proper routes

test_cases.expected: CTA section exists near bottom of page
Headline with encouraging text like 'Ready to get started?' or similar

test_cases.expected: Get Started or Sign Up button exists in CTA section

test_cases.input: Click CTA button in final section

test_cases.input: Query for Sign In link in final section

scenarios.name: Demo URL Input (Teaser)
scenarios.description: Validates the optional demo URL shortening input that provides a teaser experience for unauthenticated users and prompts them to sign up.

steps.description: Find the demo URL input field on the homepage
steps.context: This is a 'Could' priority feature - may be optional

steps.description: Enter a URL and attempt to shorten it
steps.context: Should redirect to registration or show modal

steps.description: Confirm user is prompted to sign up to use the feature

test_cases.input: Query for URL input field in demo section
test_cases.expected: Input field exists with placeholder text for URL entry

test_cases.input: Query for 'Shorten' or submit button near input
test_cases.expected: Submit button exists to trigger demo action

test_cases.input: Enter valid URL 'https://example.com' and click submit
test_cases.expected: User is redirected to /register or modal appears prompting sign-up

test_cases.input: Verify input field has proper URL validation feedback
test_cases.expected: Invalid URL shows visual error indication or message

test_cases.input: Check demo input is not functional without authentication
test_cases.expected: URL shortening does not actually occur - only prompts registration
Input has associated label or aria-label for screen readers

scenarios.name: Responsive Design
scenarios.description: Validates that the homepage displays correctly across mobile (<768px), tablet (768-1024px), and desktop (>1024px) viewports with appropriate layout adaptations.

steps.description: Verify homepage layout and functionality at mobile width (<768px)
Verify homepage layout at tablet width (768-1024px)
Verify homepage layout at desktop width (>1024px)
Confirm content doesn't overflow horizontally at any viewport

test_cases.expected: All content is visible without horizontal scrolling
All buttons and links have minimum 44px tap target size
All text is readable without zooming, minimum 16px font for body text
Layout adapts appropriately for tablet viewport
Full desktop layout with multi-column grids where appropriate

test_cases.input: Check hero CTA visibility at 768px width
test_cases.expected: Get Started button remains visible above the fold

test_cases.input: Verify images and media scale appropriately
test_cases.expected: Images resize proportionally without distortion
Navigation is mobile-optimized (hamburger menu if applicable)

scenarios.name: Theme System Integration
scenarios.description: Validates that the homepage correctly integrates with the existing theme system, supporting light, dark, and other DaisyUI themes with consistent visual presentation.

steps.description: Verify homepage appearance in light theme mode
Toggle to dark theme and verify appearance
Verify theme toggle functionality works on homepage
steps.context: User should be able to switch themes

steps.description: Check all elements remain readable and consistent across themes
steps.context: No broken colors or unreadable text

test_cases.input: Render homepage with light theme context
test_cases.expected: Homepage renders with light theme colors and styles

test_cases.input: Render homepage with dark theme context
test_cases.expected: Homepage renders with dark theme colors and styles
Homepage dynamically updates to new theme without page reload

test_cases.input: Verify text contrast in light theme
test_cases.expected: All text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 for normal text)

test_cases.input: Verify text contrast in dark theme
test_cases.expected: All text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio in dark mode
Homepage respects prefers-color-scheme media query

test_cases.input: Verify GlassMorphismCard appearance in both themes
test_cases.expected: Cards maintain proper glass effect and readability in both themes

test_cases.input: Verify FuturisticButton appearance in both themes
test_cases.expected: Buttons maintain proper styling and visibility in both themes

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Validates WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance including semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and reduced motion preferences.

steps.description: Check proper HTML5 semantic elements and heading hierarchy
Navigate entire homepage using only keyboard
steps.context: Tab, Enter, Space, Escape key support

steps.description: Check ARIA labels, alt text, and landmark regions
Verify animations respect prefers-reduced-motion setting

test_cases.expected: Exactly one H1, logical H2/H3 hierarchy without skipping levels
Page has main, header (if navbar), and appropriate sections

test_cases.input: Check all images for alt text
test_cases.expected: All img elements have meaningful alt text or empty alt for decorative

test_cases.input: Check all icons for accessible names
test_cases.expected: Icons have aria-label or aria-hidden with adjacent text label
All buttons, links, inputs are reachable via Tab key in logical order

test_cases.input: Verify focus indicators on all interactive elements
test_cases.expected: Visible focus ring appears on focus for all interactive elements
Skip link exists and moves focus to main content

test_cases.input: Activate buttons with Enter and Space keys
test_cases.expected: All buttons respond to both Enter and Space key activation
Framer Motion animations are disabled or reduced

test_cases.input: Verify form labels for demo input
test_cases.expected: Input fields have associated labels (label element or aria-label)
No information conveyed by color alone (icons/text supplement color)

steps.description: Check that all sections are properly assembled in correct order
steps.context: Hero, Features, How It Works, Stats, CTA, Demo

steps.description: Verify anchor links scroll smoothly to sections
Verify links to /login, /register work correctly
Check page load performance and animation smoothness

test_cases.expected: Homepage renders without errors
Sections appear in order: Hero, Features, How It Works, (Stats), CTA
BackgroundEffect component renders and displays visual effects
Page scrolls smoothly to features section
Page scrolls smoothly to how it works section
Register page loads correctly
Login page loads correctly

test_cases.input: Navigate back to homepage from login
test_cases.expected: Homepage loads correctly with browser back button
Page sections animate in smoothly on initial load
Homepage properly consumes ThemeContext for styling
Homepage can detect authentication state if needed
Page becomes interactive within 3 seconds
